events.text_en: Phan Vật Hoa of Thiên Bảo Trai sets a grain of Xích Kim's red gold in her own dantian to grow by the Warm-Nurtured Treasure Sutra.
The vault furnace of Thiên Bảo Trai bursts while Ung Thiên Kim refines the studio's ingot; her disciple Phan Vật Hoa melts her gear into it.
Thiên Bảo Trai's auction steward tells Lạc Hà's envoy what the surety of 1179 is, for the price of his gambling debt.
Khang Thiên Chùy cuts a second key from the Lone Duck Ring at the Xích Kim furnace and tells his mistress it has failed.
